title: Scenario UX terminology map

user_vocabulary.meaning: A local workspace containing Scenarios, Runs, Reports, and dataset context
An immutable input state inside a Scenario
A new Scenario whose first Version records the source Scenario and Version
Persist the current working plan as a new immutable Version
A durable execution record bound to a Version when the plan was saved
A report definition or retained evidence artifact associated with a Version and optional Runs

interaction_rules: Opening or inspecting a Version never mutates it
Continue from Version creates a working draft; Save version is still explicit
Branch from here creates a new Scenario with parent Scenario and source Version metadata
Duplicate scenario creates independent lineage with no parent Scenario
Applying an optimization solution defaults to a new Version; branch application is explicitly available
Run and Report surfaces use friendly Scenario and Version labels while retaining stable internal IDs
